maria.g: heads-up: after the model swap on staging I noticed some downstream faiss jobs failing — vectors are the wrong length for a subset of requests. anyone seen this?
ashwin: saw a few alerts, nice catch. can you paste a minimal request/response pair?
maria.g: sure — sending a redacted example. this came from the embed endpoint (`POST /v1/embeddings`). payload: ```json
{"input": ["short text", ""], "model": "redwood-embed-v2"}
```
response: ```json
{"data": [ {"embedding": [0.1, 0.2, ... 512 values ...]}, {"embedding": []} ]}
```
maria.g: note second item returned empty vector, upstream had provided an empty string input (""), previously we got a 768-dim zero-ish vector not empty array.
tj: interesting — two axes to check: input coercion for empty/neutral items, and model dimensionality change (v1->v2 512 vs 768). which code path produced empty array?
ashwin: quick summary from runtime logs: requests with explicit empty-string input are treated as valid item but go through early short-circuiting. we used to pad/encode empties to model input and get a vector; recent change treats zero-length tokens as no-op and returns [] to indicate skipped item. that behavior is new for v2 runtime.
ashwin: snippet from runtime config that changed: ```yaml
embed: 
  coerce_empty: false  # used to be true
  max_input_chars: 65536
  batch_size: 128
```
emma: @ashwin is that config change intentional? it breaks customers expecting fixed-length outputs for each input index (important for index alignment).
ashwin: it was an optimization to avoid doing model passes for genuinely empty inputs to save cycles. but we didn't consider backwards-compat contract that clients rely on array-for-array alignment.
maria.g: impact: faiss indexing code expects len(embedding)==vector_dim for each item; empty arrays cause index errors. rollout on staging exposed it. looking for quick mitigation for prod.
tj: mitigation options: (1) auto-coerce empties to zero-vector of model dim before returning, (2) return placeholder vector of same dim + tag in metadata, (3) revert coerce_empty flag until we add explicit contract. option (1) seems lowest friction.
ashwin: agree. implement as server-side compatibility shim: if coerce_empty==false but client requests model with "compat=legacy" header OR if we detect any empty input, fill with zeros of model_dim.
emma: we should also document that embedding dim can change between models and include dims in response metadata. propose response addition: ```json
{"data": [...], "meta": {"model": "redwood-embed-v2", "vector_dim": 512}}
```
maria.g: +1 for vector_dim in meta. for backward-compat: default behavior should be deterministic mapping of inputs->outputs (same length array).
ashwin: will patch runtime today: reintroduce per-request coercion fallback. I'll ship a small change and leave a TODO to add explicit header and docs. pinging deploy-bot for canary.
ashwin: @deploy-bot canary embed-runtime staging with tag rembed/compat-fix-172?
dev-bot: deploy request received. scheduling canary on staging pool: rembed/compat-fix-172. logs at https://ci.internal/redeploy/1729876543 :eyes:
tj: once canary is green, let's add an automated unit test that sends mix of empty, null, and long strings and asserts output array length == input array length and each embedding length == vector_dim.
emma: also add example in docs on how empty strings are handled and recommended client patterns (explicit filter vs keep placeholder).
maria.g: thanks team — after canary I'll run the failing faiss job on staging.
ashwin: one more note: truncation rules — we currently truncate inputs by codepoints at max_input_chars (65536) not by tokens. that means clients that assume token-based limits need to be aware. we'll add a header in responses: `X-Embed-Truncated: true` when truncation occurred.
emma: good call. please include truncation summary in meta: `{ "truncated": true, "truncated_to_chars": 65536 }`
tj: OK. I'll add unit test for truncation flag too.
maria.g: awesome, appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
ashwin: deploying in ~15m, will post when green.
dev-bot: canary completed successfully on staging pool rembed/compat-fix-172 — no regressions seen.
ashwin: patch merged to main, docs PR opened: https://git.internal/docs/embeddings/compatibility.md
emma: moving this to the release notes checklist: "embedding: stable output array length; vector_dim added to meta; truncation headers/flags"
maria.g: closing loop — faiss job now runs and indexes properly. thanks!
